_meta.description: Closed enum of reasons a row carries strategy='passthrough' or 'needs_reprice'. kind=intentional means the passthrough is the correct final answer and repair passes must not touch it. kind=defect means something failed and the row must be countable by gates.

no_gcp_equivalent.label: No GCP equivalent
no_gcp_equivalent.description: GCP has no comparable service or charge type. Permanent decision made by a static mapper or service_map.

unit_model_mismatch.label: Unit models incompatible
unit_model_mismatch.description: Both clouds charge for this, but in units that cannot be converted (e.g. S3 per-1k requests vs GCS class-A ops, Aurora I/O vs Cloud SQL).

accelerator_manual_sizing.label: Accelerator — manual sizing
accelerator_manual_sizing.description: Inferentia/Trainium/GPU workload. No automatic equivalent; requires human sizing.

service_policy_review.label: Policy: review
service_policy_review.description: data/service_map.json declares mode='review' for this service.

family_not_available_in_region.label: Family not available in region
family_not_available_in_region.description: GCP does not offer this instance family in this region, but does offer it elsewhere.

no_rate_in_region.label: No rate in region
no_rate_in_region.description: A GCP SKU was identified, but no rate is reachable in this region or global fallback.

unresolved_sku.label: No SKU resolved
unresolved_sku.description: We intended to map this row, but no catalog SKU or no region-reachable rate was found.

storage_misroute_backstop.label: Storage misroute backstop
storage_misroute_backstop.description: A non-storage service was mapped onto Cloud Storage and was rerouted to passthrough.

echo_reset.label: Echo bug reset
echo_reset.description: gcp_service echoed the AWS product name back; reset to passthrough.

detail_less_row.label: No charge-type detail
detail_less_row.description: The source bill has no unit/operation/usage_type detail, so no mechanic can price the row.

llm_dropped.label: LLM left row unmapped
llm_dropped.description: The Phase-2 LLM produced no mapping for this row; ensure_full_coverage backstopped it.

llm_veto.label: LLM vetoed the fix
llm_veto.description: A review or outlier candidate was vetoed and the row stayed at AWS cost.

clamped_outlier.label: Clamped over-projection
clamped_outlier.description: The projected GCP cost exceeded the plausibility threshold and was clamped.

mapper_error.label: Mapper raised
mapper_error.description: The deterministic mapper for this mechanic_group raised an exception.

unclassified.label: Reason not declared
unclassified.description: A passthrough was written without declaring a reason. Always a bug in the writing script. Also used for LLM-authored passthroughs, which may never self-declare intent.
